content.stem: 一家美国金融机构的合规官收到大陪审团传票，要求提供与涉及一名政治公众人物（PEP）的正在进行的洗钱调查相关的客户记录。合规官首先应该做什么？

options.A: 通知客户并征求其同意
options.B: 咨询机构法律顾问，评估传票的有效性并确定适当的应对措施
options.C: 立即向大陪审团提供记录
options.D: 提交一份可疑活动报告（SAR），说明收到传票的情况

content.stem_en: A compliance officer at a U.S. financial institution receives a grand jury subpoena requesting customer records related to an ongoing money laundering investigation involving a politically exposed person (PEP). What should the compliance officer do first?

options_en.A: Notify the customer and seek consent
options_en.B: Consult with the institution's legal counsel to assess validity and determine the appropriate response
options_en.C: Immediately provide records to the grand jury
options_en.D: File a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) describing receipt of the subpoena
